FAQ.TITLE: Frequently
FAQ.SUBTITLE: We answer your questions about how we drive your company's digital transformation from Gijón.
FAQ.QUESTION_1: What services does TÁCTICA TIC offer?
FAQ.ANSWER_1: We specialize in custom software development, industrial and business process automation, technology consulting, and digital strategy design to help companies evolve and become more efficient.
FAQ.QUESTION_2: Do you only work with companies in Asturias or throughout Spain?
FAQ.ANSWER_2: Our headquarters are located in Gijón (Asturias), allowing us to provide close support to the local business community. However, thanks to our remote working methodology, we develop and implement technological solutions for clients throughout Spain.
FAQ.QUESTION_3: What is the work process once I contact you?
FAQ.ANSWER_3: We begin with a consulting and analysis phase to thoroughly understand your needs and bottlenecks. After designing a tailored strategy, we move on to agile and transparent software development, followed by implementation, team training, and ongoing support.
FAQ.QUESTION_4: Can your technology solutions integrate with tools we already use?
FAQ.ANSWER_4: Absolutely! One of our core principles is connecting tools and optimizing processes. We design robust software capable of integrating with your existing systems (ERPs, CRMs, or industrial machinery) through APIs to ensure a smooth and intelligent transition.
